messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Quick thread to get AWS/GCP/Azure listing preflight into a single place. Need IAM pattern, KMS access, trial SKU mapping, publisher packaging.json, screenshots, and a final offer manifest. Target: finish preflight by Friday.
Mason (Legal): On it. Will check export restrictions and draft a short EULA excerpt for the store. free at 10:30am PT for a short sync.
Aisha (Product): I can push packaging.json v0 with trial_days and limits. Thinking 14d free trial + 50k token cap for hosted. Will add a short summary for listing copy.
Kai (Ops): For AWS private offers we need a publisher role and a KMS key ARN. Example IAM policy snippet we use for publisher: 
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-1234"}] }
```
Kai (Ops): Also: provide staging container image tag and region manifest. I can generate the manifest once packaging.json is final.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: please attach required artifacts: packaging.json, screenshots (1200x628), privacy-eu note, and AMI/container manifest. Docs: https://internal.redwood/marketplace-guide
Ravi (Design): I'll sketch 3 screenshot variants after product copy lands. prefer to keep captions < 10 words.
Tess (Growth): growth recommends a 14-day trial for consistency with other promos. Also confirm whether trial auto-converts or requires explicit billing setup.
Aisha (Product): Packaging draft pushed: {"trial_days":"14","token_cap":"50000","seat_limit":"1","trial_auto_convert":"false"} — open to changes. Will add marketing-friendly bullets for the listing.
Mason (Legal): Redlines: add data residency clause for EU customers and a permitted-uses clause. I'll paste a short EULA snippet to the ticket.
Nina (Partnerships): Plan: sync 10:30am PT tomorrow, deliverables before sync: Kai attaches staging manifest, Aisha updates packaging.json with listing copy, Mason posts EULA snippet, Ravi prepares screenshot concepts. I'll file the intake ticket and assign owners.
marketplace-bot: Ticket created: MP-4712 "Marketplace listing preflight: multi-cloud packaging + legal" Assignees: Nina, Kai, Aisha. Link: https://linear.redwood/MP-4712
Aisha (Product): noted. tagging product-ops to review metric hooks for telemetry in the listing.
Kai (Ops): I'll upload sandbox creds and manifest after legal approval. Will post link here.
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks team. If anything blocks, drop updates here and I'll escalate to GTM. :pray:
